name: aieng-platform
description: AI engineering practice platform — monorepo (web + API + shared packages)

scripts.dev: npm run dev:api & npm run dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @aieng/shared && npm run build -w @aieng/api && npm run build -w @aieng/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @aieng/shared && npm run typecheck -ws --if-present
